name: Zotero Math Inline Fixer
description: Fix math formulas pasted into Zotero/Better Notes notes that fail to render: converts single-char $f$, inline $(11,20)$, and standalone $$...$$ blocks into proper math_inline nodes. Includes a clipboard-converter window (toolbar icon / Ctrl+Alt+A): paste raw AI Markdown/LaTeX, preview the Better Notes-compatible conversion, copy, then paste into your note.
author: wangce
